title: Velmora Font
author: Colourful
description:
VELMORA — Elegant Fashion Serif Font
Introducing Velmora, an elegant high-contrast serif display font designed to bring a sophisticated, refined, and editorial feel to your creative projects.
With its tall proportions, dramatic thick-and-thin contrast, graceful curves, and luxurious appearance, Velmora is perfect for designs that need a premium and fashionable aesthetic.
Whether you’re creating a luxury brand identity, fashion editorial, wedding stationery, or elegant social media graphics, Velmora adds a distinctive and timeless character to your typography.
Perfect For:
Luxury branding and logos
Fashion magazines and editorials
Beauty and cosmetics branding
Perfume and skincare packaging
Wedding invitations and stationery
Boutique branding
Elegant posters
Social media graphics
Product packaging
Editorial designs
Headlines and display typography
Creative advertising
Font Features:
Elegant high-contrast serif style
Tall and sophisticated letterforms
Fashion-forward editorial appearance
Suitable for luxury and premium branding
Perfect for headlines and display designs
Versatile for both digital and print projects
File Included:
File Type: OTF Only
This font is ideal for designers, small businesses, fashion brands, wedding creators, bloggers, and anyone looking to add a luxurious editorial touch to their designs.
Please note: This is a digital font product. No physical item will be shipped.
